   Title: Parks & Recreation Commission Annual Report

   Location:      Parks and Recreation Commission

   Responsible Staff Member: John Stark, Director of Parks & Recreation

   Background: City Council Resolution No. 2019-088 requires the Parks & Recreation Commission
   to report their activities to the City Council annually.

   Issue and Discussion:       The Parks & Recreation Commission Annual Report provides a
   summary of the items considered by the commission during the reporting period and is submitted
   to the City Council for acceptance. This report details the activities for 2026. Members of the
   commission are Jerry Bindel, David Gregorich, Margie Kovarik-Maxhimer, Trudi Morgan, Peter
   Fink and Nicole Ramirez Thomas. Mark Costigan resigned from the commission effective August
   31, 2026. There is currently one vacant commission position.

              2026.
             Furniture, fixtures and equipment purchasing for Rec Center opening.
             Contract services and technical services contracts established for maintenance,
              preventative maintenance and janitorial of Rec Center.
             Implementation of staffing and operational schedule for Rec Center.
             Instructor contracts and rentals established for Rec Center.
             The Aquatics program is fully staffed with lifeguards and instructors; swim lessons and

City of South Lake Tahoe
                                            Report to
                    Parks and Recreation Commission


Meeting Date: September 16, 2026


Title: Parks Foundation Update

Location:    Parks and Recreation Commission

Responsible Staff Member: John Stark, Director of Parks & Recreation (530) 307-9145


Background:          On July 19, 2023, during the Parks and Recreation Commission Meeting,
Commissioners requested staff prepare a report to update on the status of the Parks Foundation.
This includes plans for fundraising for items related to the interior of the new Multigenerational
Recreation & Aquatics Center and for scholarship access. On August 16, 2023, commissioners
requested to keep this as an ongoing item for updates. The Parks Foundation last met September
14, 2026, and the topics listed below were discussed:


      Treasurer’s report
      Scholarship program MOU
      Foundation tournament update
      Internal Processes Subcommittee
      Middle School Access Program
      Multicultural Celebration


Issue and Discussion: City staff will add this item to unfinished business for the September
17, 2026, meeting for city staff updates and discussion by Commissioners.

Financial Implications:     There are no financial implications.


Environmental Considerations: There are no environmental implications.


Policy Implications:        There are no policy implications.
